- `ApplyCutRecipe` uses `CreateOperation` and its validation. Undo uses the same command.

- Trial merge: upstream main `58ecbebb06bb5e143056a9eb478939977f0fb58a`. The first parent is the reviewed PR head.

- `mcp_doc_drift`, included in quick: 6 passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: all 207 planned steps passed, 49 tests passed, zero failures, 23.2 minutes. This review ran every reached app target locally. The author body had no heavy result.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 3 steps passed, zero failures, 2.3 minutes. Both motion light targets passed.

Safety checks:

- This review treats the new path inputs as safety work.
- I disabled the missing-tool guard. `cut_recipe_with_a_missing_tool_is_refused_by_name` failed because the error lost the recipe name.
- I disabled the material-mismatch guard. `cut_recipe_with_an_unknown_or_other_material_is_refused_by_name` failed because apply succeeded.
- I restored the original bytes. All four recipe tests then passed. No source changes remain.
- The PR changes no goldens. There are no moved golden lines to check.

Extra suites run:

- The four recipe tests ran again after the mutations.
- Additional MCP checks reproduced both findings below against the trial merge.
- No fixture or importer path changed. The conditional fixture-reader and kernel suites do not apply.

Requested before merge:

1. **[P2] Resolve geometry from the new source.** `crates/app/src/commands/operation/recipe.rs:48` copies `recipe.params` without replacing geometry inside those parameters. Drill parameters include stored hole coordinates, radii, and floors. I imported two plates. Their holes were at `(0, 0)` and `(10, 0)`. I saved the first drilling operation and applied its recipe with `source: "new"`. The new operation kept `xy: [0, 0]`. `generate` returned `status: "ok"`. `verify` then reported `gouge` and blocked the post. Derive the hole data from the new source, or refuse the recipe by name until its geometry is supplied. Check other parameters that store geometry, including bore holes and excluded edge picks. Add a regression test that transfers the recipe between these two sources.

2. **[P2] Refuse a named material when the destination material is absent.** `crates/app/src/commands/operation/recipe.rs:38` checks the material only when both values are `Some`. I saved `Aluminium face` with stock material `aluminium_6061` and feed `900`. I cleared the stock material and applied the recipe. Apply returned success and kept feed `900`. No document material was set. An absent destination material does not confirm that those feeds fit. Require a matching material in force when the recipe names one. Refuse an absent material with the recipe name. Add command and MCP tests for this case.

Notes:

- Verification blocked the incorrect drilling path in the reproduction. I did not observe incorrect posted G-code.
- The PR changes no UI files. Before/after screenshots do not apply.
- The PR remains a draft. The review worktree and branch remain in place to keep the build warm.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

- Saved geometry: the command now refuses recipes with geometry that the API cannot replace. The refusal names the recipe. Pins: `cut_recipe_does_not_transfer_holes_to_a_different_source`, `cut_recipe_refuses_other_saved_coordinates_by_name`, and `cut_recipe_refuses_saved_picks_and_plane_origins`. Removing the guard made all three fail.
- Absent destination material: a named recipe material now requires a matching material in force. Pins: `cut_recipe_with_a_named_material_requires_a_destination_material` and `cut_recipe_mcp_refuses_an_absent_destination_material`. Restoring the old guard made both fail.

After restoration, all nine recipe tests passed. The final quick gate passed: 337 steps, 2,666 tests passed, zero failures. Clippy passed with `-D warnings`. The catalog suite passed: 37 regular tests and all four ignored tests in the heavy gate. No program or golden file changed.

Heavy gate: GREEN. 206 steps, zero gate failures, 46 tests passed (28.2 minutes). Two registered known-fail tests (#1950 and #2849) failed as expected; the gate accepted these results.

Requested before merge:

1. **[P3] Refuse saved contour start and exit picks.** [crates/app/src/commands/operation/recipe.rs:77](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/blob/e8eb8429461c63a4df20d11dca24e0a71582c34f/crates/app/src/commands/operation/recipe.rs#L77) checks only `chain_overrides` for a contour. Its `links.approach.start_point` and `exit_point` also hold source coordinates. They pass through this guard unchanged. I saved a contour with start `[35, 0]` and exit `[0, 25]`. I applied its recipe to a second box translated by 100 mm in X. Apply returned success and created `New` with both old picks. Generation then refused the start pick. After I cleared the start, generation refused the exit pick. A fresh contour with the same settings and no saved picks generated successfully on that source. Check both fields before creating the operation. Refuse them with the recipe name, or require replacement picks. Add separate command and MCP tests for each field.

Reproduction output:

```text
generate: New - could not generate the toolpath: New: invalid machining parameters: start point (35.000, 0.000) is 30.000 mm from the nearest cutter path, farther than the 15.000 mm a start point may sit from it - pick on or beside the wall to cut
generate: New - could not generate the toolpath: New: invalid machining parameters: exit point (0.000, 25.000) is 65.180 mm from the nearest cutter path, farther than the 15.000 mm a exit point may sit from it - pick on or beside the wall to cut
```

Safety checks:

- This is a safety-tier review because recipes supply parameters to toolpath generation.
- I removed the saved-geometry guard. The three geometry regression tests failed: 6 passed, 3 failed.
- I restored the old material condition. Both absent-material tests failed: 7 passed, 2 failed.
- I restored the original file bytes. All nine recipe tests then passed. No source changes remain.
- Goldens moved: none in the PR diff. There are no moved golden lines to check.

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test golden_cl`: 33 passed, zero failures.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test cut_recipe` after mutation restoration: 9 passed, zero failures.
- `app suites: example_catalog`: 37 passed in quick. `app heavy: example_catalog`: all 4 ignored cases passed. Combined: 41 of 41 passed.
- `app suites: mcp_doc_drift`: 6 passed in quick.
- Every mapped golden suite passed. The PR moved no recorded programs or golden files. The working tree is clean.
- The MCP transfer checks above reproduced the remaining finding. The fresh-operation control generated successfully.
- No fixture or importer path changed. The conditional fixture-reader and kernel suites do not apply.

Notes:

- No UI files changed. Before/after screenshots do not apply.
- The PR stays a draft because of the finding.
- The review worktree and `review-3399` branch remain in place to keep the build warm.
